reason: COMPLEX. The first thing I noticed was the QR code on every sachet that opens the lab report for that batch, and that the sachet is small enough to toss in my tote next to the charger. I already take a multi-form complex, so I would try one box of the 3-form, but it is double what I pay in a flash sale, so I would not commit to more until I see if it does anything.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? $29.99 is about twice what I pay for my usual magnesium, and the lab report does not tell me if it works.
would_change_my_mind: A price closer to $20 or a starter deal, or a creator I trust saying her sleep or cramps really changed after a couple of weeks.
